company.shortDescription: Rapidfolio provides AI workflow automation for compliance and operations in banks and fintechs.
company.description: Rapidfolio provides an AI workflow platform for banks, fintechs, lenders, payment processors, and other regulated businesses. The platform converts documented procedures into AI-agent workflows that can be tested, deployed through APIs or operational triggers, and reviewed through audit records. It supports processes such as KYC and KYB reviews, sanctions screening, loan underwriting, fraud investigations, disputes, reconciliation, and account reviews. Rapidfolio integrates with third-party systems and allows human approval steps within automated procedures. Its services include workflow execution, data connections, automated browsing, documentation, and technical support.

productsAndServices.description: An AI workflow platform that automates compliance, operations, risk, fraud, and customer-service procedures for regulated businesses.
